lane: SYSTEM AND SETTINGS (POLISH 3): System, Settings, Me, THE LOOK

features.name: System: the honest line
features.does: One line at the top: WORKING, or exactly what is not, with the time it was checked.

features.name: Keys
features.does: Shows the two keys you need and the optional ones, each with HOW TO GET IT steps; keys are locked away and never shown again.

features.name: AI models and AI room
features.where: ME → SYSTEM → Status → AI MODELS / AI ROOM
say: how much free room is left today?
features.does: Which free brains are connected, and how much of today's free allowance is left, with units and the time.

features.name: Storage
say: how much space are you using?
features.does: What the phone and the brain are storing, the biggest things named in words, with sizes.

features.name: Health
features.does: Every ability with a works/does-not mark, the brain's jobs and feeds with their last run, the keys you have and the ones still missing, and anything you said felt off.

features.name: Report card and foresight
say: how right have your predictions been?
features.does: What I expected (rain, a late train, your commute) scored against what really happened, as a percentage with a count.
features.note: The commute needs the free TomTom key.

features.name: Independence meter and Sovereign mode
say: how much stayed on the phone this week?
features.does: How much of what you asked was answered on your own brains over 7 and 30 days, week by week, and what Sovereign mode (cloud off) would stop.
features.note: Telegram questions are not counted yet.

features.name: Offline brain training (self-training)
say: how did this week's training go?
features.does: Each week I train the small phone brain for free on Kaggle and keep it only if it tests better; TRAIN NOW, ROLLBACK, and a plain report of what changed.
features.note: Needs your free Kaggle and Hugging Face keys; until a week has really finished on Kaggle it says it has not been tried for real.

features.name: Daily GPU, loops and night school
features.does: Optional extra free practice each day and overnight, each asked for first and reported in plain words.
features.note: Depends on the same free keys; off until you allow it.

features.name: Phone hardware card
features.does: Reads the screen's refresh rate, memory and graphics, and times the offline brain on your phone.

features.name: Backup and restore
say: when did you last back up?
features.does: Once a day, a locked copy of what lives only on this phone (courses, plans, documents, photo edits, video projects, settings), its size said before you tap; RESTORE puts back whatever is newer.
features.note: The photos and clips themselves stay on the phone; faces and voices are never backed up.

features.name: Reboot and forget owner key
say: forget the owner key on this phone
features.does: Restarts Ghosty, or makes this phone forget its key, each with a confirm first.

features.name: Theme: seven looks, twelve colours
features.does: Changes the whole look (scan, map, eye, orbit, grown, ink, glass) and the colour, by tap or by plain colour words.

features.name: THE LOOK
features.does: How I draw everything: the colours and their jobs, the type, the marks (tap one to see it work), my orb, and the themes, grounds and switches.

features.name: Reading
say: read my books in your voice
features.does: Text size up to the biggest (BODY 21), how a book is shown, and who reads it aloud.

features.name: Name and units
features.does: What I call you, metric or imperial, and where home is.

features.name: Permissions
say: what can you use on my phone?
why do you need the microphone?
features.does: Each phone permission, what I use it for, and what I never do with it.

features.name: Character
features.does: Dials for how dry, warm, firm and brief I am, saved to the brain so the app, voice, Telegram and notices all sound the same.

features.name: Principles
features.where: ME → SETTINGS → You → CHARACTER (lines I hold to)
say: always tell me when you're unsure
features.does: Lines in your own words that I hold to.

features.name: Guardian
features.does: Watches near your places, WALK ME HOME, the panic phrase and scam checks; your position goes with a walk message only if you switch that on.

features.name: Voice and home
say: stop when I talk over you
features.does: How I speak, whether you can talk over me, interface sounds and the Home screen.

features.name: My voice and people I know
features.where: ME → SETTINGS → Voice & home → MY VOICE / PEOPLE I KNOW
features.does: I learn your voice and the people you introduce, kept on this phone only; it helps me know it is you but is never a lock.

features.name: Voice model
features.where: ME → SETTINGS → Voice & home → VOICE MODEL
features.does: A small free download (41 MB, on Wi-Fi, on your tap) that tells voices apart better.

features.name: Faces
features.does: Your face and those you introduce, kept on the phone, with UNDO; a stranger is never identified.

features.name: Offline brain
features.does: Pick and download a phone brain (0.6B to 4B), its size and memory said, when the phone answers, TEST after it loads.
features.note: Whether a bigger one fits is only known by trying on the phone.

features.name: Search by meaning
features.does: A 70 MB download that lets the library and offline brain find passages by what they mean.

features.name: Offline eyes and maps
features.where: ME → SETTINGS → Ghosty → OFFLINE EYES / OFFLINE MAPS
features.does: The Lens's on-phone models and offline map areas, each with size, licence and Wi-Fi.
features.note: Only one size of the eyes for now: no larger free model with a clear licence yet.

features.name: Links, shortcuts, the wall, workspace
features.does: Connected services, Siri shortcut links, a screen of mine on a TV or second display, and the workspace.

features.name: Share to Ghosty
features.does: Files you share go to the library; words or a link land in my ask line, never sent by themselves.
features.note: Needs Ghosty installed to the Home Screen.

features.name: About, help and the origin page
features.does: Who made me, when I was born, what I am made of and my promises, What's New, and help.

features.name: One sentence a screen
features.does: Every line is one sentence; the rest is behind a WHY right under it.

upward.idea: A daily health digest in the Brief
upward.why: One morning line saying everything worked overnight, or the one thing that did not, with a fix key
upward.builds_on: Health, the honest line, the Brief

upward.why: Where Health finds a known problem (a feed down, a key expired, storage nearly full), offer the exact fix in one tap instead of only naming it
A week-by-week chart of the offline brain's test scores per area, so you see it actually getting better
upward.builds_on: Training report, the report card's sparkline

upward.why: Before RESTORE, show exactly what would come back and what is newer here, item by item, with a choice per item
Export the locked backup as one file you keep (Files or iCloud Drive), so it never depends only on the brain
Point the camera or pick a photo and I build a look from its colours, still checked for readability
upward.builds_on: THE LOOK's tokens and contrast floor, Theme

upward.why: Ink by day, a dark look after sunset, calm motion at night, automatically
Terse at work hours, warmer in the evening, by your own rules
A plain log of every time the camera, microphone or position was actually used, and by which screen
One number for how much works with no signal right now (brain, eyes, maps, meaning), with what to download next and its size
Show how fast each screen opens on this phone and flag any that got slower after an update
A short, skippable path that sets keys, voice, faces, backup and the offline brain in order, each with why
upward.builds_on: First run, Keys, My voice, Backup

upward.why: Bold text, higher contrast, reduce transparency and VoiceOver hints as real switches, checked in all seven looks

sideways.why: A switch that pauses heavy work (training downloads, feeds) on low battery or mobile data and says what paused
sideways.builds_on: Phone hardware card, the Wi-Fi rule

sideways.why: Everything I know about you in one place by kind (memory, faces, voices, places), with forget keys
A complete copy of your data in open formats (documents, sheets, notes) whenever you want it
Set up another device with a scan of a code, its own backups kept apart
No spoken notices or pushes in hours you choose, urgent Guardian alerts still through
Choose what the Home Screen and lock-screen shortcuts show, drawn from the same looks
Every screen's spoken phrases in one searchable page, tap to try

sideways.idea: What changed since you last looked
sideways.why: After an update, a short tour of only the screens that changed
Warn before a free allowance runs out or a key stops working, with the steps to renew
Someone you introduced gets their own name and look, recognised by voice as a convenience only, never unlocking your things
Big-text, voice-first layouts that switch on with CarPlay-like or TV connections

cross.idea: Backup carries the comic studio's projects and the game studio's games
cross.why: Your made things survive a lost phone like documents now do

cross.idea: Character dials shape Telegram and the radio's spoken links
cross.why: One voice everywhere, set in one place

cross.idea: Training learns from School and Gym results
cross.why: The offline brain gets better at exactly what you practise

cross.idea: Independence meter counts the Lens and Interpreter working offline
cross.why: A true picture of what works with no signal

cross.idea: Theme follows the boot film's colours and God's Eye's night mode
cross.why: The whole app feels like one designed thing

cross.idea: Health watches the money pack's price watchers and the Guardian's jobs
cross.why: You hear early when a watch or alert stopped working
